title: Opening night: Indi's messaging cleared by security; the iOS conductor needs your word; the web app and /contribute/ wait for your yes
headline: Today: three apps and their line (/apps/), power users, how we work, team messaging, contributors (Andrew, the first, in the WhatsApp group), the security agent across every repository, five conductors on a rota, the shared mobile repository with one set of schedule rules, and the news app on the web. Indi's team merged messaging v1 and the Team app redesign into iOS dev; security.repos@ found no blocker. But nobody can promote them: the iOS conductor is conductor@ios.PrompTugal.dinis on account B, not scheduled, and it waits for your 'Shall I?'. The web app and /contribute/ wait for your yes in PrompTugal's session, under security@'s six conditions.
